# SteveJung-Portfolio

Steve Jung's bilingual portfolio site. Static HTML/JS on Vercel, one serverless
function under `api/`. See README.md for the full file map; this file covers the
things that are easy to get wrong.

## Generated files — never edit by hand

| File | Generated by |
| --- | --- |
| `ko/index.html`, `ko/case-study.html` | `tools/sync-locale-pages.mjs` |
| the `<head>` block in all four pages | `tools/sync-locale-pages.mjs` |
| `sitemap.xml` | `tools/sync-locale-pages.mjs` |
| `support.js` | the separate `dc-runtime` project |

Edit `index.html`, `case-study.html`, `i18n/en.js`, `i18n/ko.js` — then run:

```bash
npm run sync-locales    # regenerates ko/, the heads, and sitemap.xml
npm run check-locales   # exits non-zero if any output is stale
```

`check-locales` must pass before you commit. A change to a template or to a
copy file that skips the sync ships English markup to the Korean routes.

## Asset paths must be root-absolute

`/images/…`, `/pdf/…` — never `images/…`. A relative path resolves against
`/ko/` on the Korean routes and 404s there. This is the single most common way
to break this site.

## Copy lives in i18n, not in the templates

`i18n/en.js` and `i18n/ko.js` hold all page copy, including the head tags. The
AI chat widget answers from these same files, so editing site copy is what
changes what the agent knows — there is nothing to regenerate for it.

Any copy change must be made in **both** language files. Links the templates
declare as locale-relative use `data-lp` and are rewritten at runtime by
`i18n/locale.js`; do not hard-code `/ko/...` hrefs.

## Case-study images

`case-study.html` holds `IMG_MAP`, mapping slot codes to files:

- `C{n}-{SECTION}-BANNER` / `-MAIN` / `-D1` / `-D2` — the section hero and details
- `C{n}-GAL{k}` — the gallery tiles under the case

Gallery tiles are driven by the `gallery:` label array in **both** i18n files.
The number of labels must equal the number of `C{n}-GAL{k}` entries, or the
trailing tiles render empty. After touching either, verify they still line up.

Filenames under `images/` contain spaces and em dashes; reference them through
the `imgPath(C{n}, '…')` helper rather than building paths by hand.

## Not deployed

`.vercelignore` excludes `pdf/Case*` (the source archive) and `tools/`. Never
link a page at anything under those paths — it resolves locally and 404s in
production. Linkable PDFs go in `pdf/` or `pdf/docs/`.

## Secrets

`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for `api/ai-steve.js` lives in the Vercel project's
environment variables. `vercel env pull` writes a local `.env`, which is
git-ignored and must stay that way. Without the key the widget degrades to a
"reach Steve directly" message and the rest of the site is unaffected.

## Deploying

Push to `main`. Vercel redeploys automatically; there is no build step for the
pages. Do not push to `main` without being asked — branch instead.

## Local preview

`npx serve .` serves the pages. `api/ai-steve.js` does not run under a static
server; use `vercel dev` if you need the chat widget.
